title: The distinction between a hollow being 'rested' vs 'bargained' (two separately tracked counters, 'Hollows rested: 3/8' and 'Hollows bargained: 1/8') is never explained at the point of choice — 'ring the recovered chapel bell' at Emberfall is only labeled '(settles this hold's grief: a bargain)' with no indication this is mechanically weaker than 'rest' until NPCs afterward volunteer 'quieter, not rested.'
